name: BLS job openings and hires
measures: US information sector openings, hires and layoffs
about: The Bureau of Labor Statistics surveys job openings, hires and layoffs by industry. We retrieve them through FRED and average them over 12 months.
attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, JOLTS, information sector [JTU5100JOL, JTU5100HIL, JTU5100LDL], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
limitations: Sector-level survey figures can move a lot from month to month.
The sector is wider than software.
